description: This file defines the FileCommitProtocol interface and related classes for managing output commit operations in Apache Spark, including job and task setup, commit, abort, and file naming specifications.

classes.name: FileCommitProtocol
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for Spark output commit protocols, including methods for job and task setup, commit, abort, and file management.

classes.name: FileCommitProtocol.TaskCommitMessage
classes.description: A serializable class representing a commit message for a task.

classes.name: FileCommitProtocol.EmptyTaskCommitMessage
classes.description: A singleton object representing an empty task commit message.

classes.name: FileNameSpec
classes.description: A case class specifying the prefix and suffix for output file names.

methods.name: FileCommitProtocol.instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a FileCommitProtocol implementation given its class name, job ID, output path, and optional dynamic partition overwrite flag.

methods.name: FileCommitProtocol.getStagingDir
methods.description: Returns the staging directory path for a given output path and job ID.
